Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: exploratory game character style-test turnaround, clean hero rendering, one landscape 3:2 PNG.
Input image 1: identity and compact computer-backpack reference ONLY. Retain the same Mexican-American man, early thirties, warm tan skin, short dark curls with the same hairline, sturdy physique, amber safety glasses. Replace his old brown outfit as specified below. Do not copy the photographic rendering or the tools.
Primary request: ONE original protagonist rendered in the clean hero visual language associated with Overwatch and Valorant: boldly designed adult human shapes, strong graphic silhouette, modestly exaggerated sturdy hands and shoulders, crisp plane changes, smooth simplified fabric and metal, exceptionally clear color blocking. This is a stylized game character presentation, neither anime nor photorealistic. He should look cool and self-assured without a costume or heroic armor.
Scene/backdrop: flat plain mid-grey, soft even neutral studio light.
Locked outfit for this entire comparison: fitted waist-length DARK CHARCOAL canvas work jacket, open enough to show a BLACK crew-neck tee; SAFETY-ORANGE lining visible on the turned-up collar and restrained orange stitch lines along the jacket seams; sleeves pushed up to just below elbows, bare tan hands; fitted dark charcoal straight work pants and sturdy dark brown work boots. Sleek matte graphite half-face respirator with TWO ORANGE filter caps, amber-tinted safety glasses. Compact clean-built charcoal/very muted olive computer backpack matching the reference's rounded rectangular silhouette, central vertical protected heat-vent and two side vents, neat secured perimeter cable runs, dark harness and small dull brass connector tips. The pack is worn in every view. No screen, no face, no glow.
Composition: exactly THREE separated views of the SAME person and outfit on ONE sheet. Large full-body FRONT at left and BACK in center at the same scale, both head to boot soles entirely in frame, generously separated, with a SMALL elevated battle-camera view at right. The small view is a whole-body three-quarter front view with the camera pointing downward from about 50 DEGREES ABOVE HORIZONTAL; clearly show the crown of his hair, tops of shoulders, backpack top, foreshortened legs and boots. It is much smaller than the two main views. Strong relaxed neutral standing stance in all views: shoulders back, feet apart, slight weight shift and one knee relaxed, hands open and held slightly off hips; no stiff T-pose, no action gesture. Front and back must be a coherent turnaround of one fixed design.
Constraints: orange is the one vivid accent; remaining clothing subdued. No white/red corporate palette, no extra color accents, no weapons, tools, badges, cap, armor, straps unrelated to the pack or extra outfit embellishments. No logos, emblems, brand marks, captions, text or watermark. No fourth view. Maintain the reference identity through stylization. Highest priority is a beautiful readable adult game silhouette and an outfit we can reproduce exactly in the two subsequent style-transfer sheets.

No visible painterly brushwork in this version. Not anime or chibi.
